content.title: Inspect the home page discovery content and preview sections
content.intent: Prove that one home-page visit shows the required discovery content: the exact heading, the catalog-size statement, all four package previews with their promised commercial fields, and four recently published book tiles.
content.technique_notes: Applied happy-path coverage by consolidating the read-only render promises that hold on first load, and applied equivalence partitioning to the package previews because each of the four cards is promised to expose the same field family (name, tagline, price, and `View package` link). No boundary, negative, covering-array, or dependency expansion applied because this path has no user input or outcome-changing combinations. Budget ceiling 8 applied; this scenario ranked 3/3 and was kept with no eviction.
